description: Implement draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 method handlers. Defines TasksBackend trait. Registers 14 methods across TaskList, Task, TaskNotification. Notable: onDestroyRemoveTasks cascade, TaskNotification/set is destroy-only, utcStart/utcDue computed on fetch (not stored), isDraft immutability enforcement (once false, cannot be set true), per-user properties in shared TaskLists, copy_task backend method. Entry point: register_tasks_handlers. Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06. Pattern: jmap-mail-server. Blocked by: jmap-tasks-types epic.
title: jmap-tasks-server: JMAP Tasks method handlers
